_notes: Hoja 331 del savegame del torneo (8x4), leida carta a carta de la imagen el 2026-10-28. CardID = 33100 + idx; 33200 = carta de personaje (hoja 332). Las cartas sueltas del mazo llevan las claves 187/188 del mod original con las mismas imagenes: la identidad es la FaceURL, el numero sale de los DeckIDs del mazo (mismo criterio que Hellboy, 19700).
Restricciones de luchador y copias de la hoja de TTS (unmatched-memory no las tiene): Baba Yaga 16, Koschei 2 (Death's Release), ANY 12.

Discrepancias con unmatched-memory (manda la carta; las entradas con `text` sobreescriben el texto del importador): Deathless dice 'Baba Yaga' (no 'Baba Yaha'); Pact Of Mortality dice 'health' (no 'healt'); Read The Bones dice 'Randomly put the rest on the bottom'; la habilidad no lleva '!'. Los cinco Pactos tienen un parrafo ONGOING y la condicion de descarte que unmatched-memory omite.

Koschei: 1 ficha (Custom_Token e0c176 en el save), vida 3, cuerpo a cuerpo, movimiento 2 (el del heroe). Empieza en el tablero (1 en tablero, 0 en reserva) en el espacio de inicio del jugador; vuelve con Deathless o Pact Of Mortality con vida 3. Baba Yaga es un standee (Custom_Assetbundle 3de904); diales ae0f05 (Koschei) y dec0a9 (Baba Yaga).
Sin formas ni contadores. La habilidad FATEFUL BARGAINS es una pasiva opcional de datos (redirect_effect_damage): hasta que el interprete de efectos la lea, el motor no la aplica.

sheet.title: Pact Of Freedom
sheet.text: Draw 2 cards. Place a hero in any space. ONGOING: Players cannot attack as their first action each turn. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

sheet.title: Pact Of Mortality
sheet.text: Return a defeated fighter to any space in Baba Yaga's zone. Set their health to 3. ONGOING: Increase all effect damage by 1, except for damage from exhaustion. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

sheet.title: Pact Of Peace
sheet.text: Deal 1 damage to each other fighter in Baba Yaga's zone. Gain 1 action. ONGOING: At the end of each turn, deal 1 damage to each hero that attacked. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

sheet.title: Pact Of Secrecy
sheet.text: All players draw up to 2 cards, then shuffle all but 2 cards from their hand into their deck. ONGOING: Players have a maximum hand size of 3. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.

sheet.title: Pact Of Time
sheet.text: Each player shuffles up to 2 cards from their discard pile into their deck. ONGOING: Players cannot gain actions. Discard this immediately if Baba Yaga takes 2 or more combat damage.
